text: im not going to type in a path to an image will you sert it to open a system window
resolution: Replaced the type-a-path import for backdrops with a NATIVE file-open window per the user's ask ('im not going to type in a path... set it to open a system window'). The Backdrops panel's primary action is now a 'Choose image...' button that opens the desktop GTK picker via zenity, driven through the existing process door (has-process, same subprocess door useAssistant uses) — no rebuild, pure TSX. On pick, the chosen path flows straight into addBackdrop (reads the file, derives aspect, places it). Cancel is a no-op; if no picker binary is on PATH the UI gracefully reveals a manual path field and says so. Built into Backdrops.tsx alongside req_1280. Verified: bundle + native build clean with -Dhas-process=true.
